shortDescription: Manage Traffic Classification Policy configuration on StorageGRID.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the StorageGRID Admin Node REST API.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: The authorization token for the API request

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the Traffic Classification Policy.

options.name: limits
options.description: Optional limits to impose on client requests matched by this traffic class. Only one of each limit type can be specified.

options.name: matchers
options.description: A set of parameters to match. The traffic class will match requests where any of these matchers match.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Traffic Classification Policy.

options.name: policy_id
options.description: Traffic Classification Policy ID. May be used for modify or delete operation.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Traffic Classification Policy should exist.
